title: Frog Pond
description: In this Modpack you can explore the World in a pre-industrialisation setting, with a few other mods wich makes the game more playable.
body: This modpack essentially reworks Minecraft, from sound mods to new texture renderings. But it's not just visual changes. Many quality-of-life mods and plugins are included to make the game easier and give it a modern feel. Add-ons like backpacks, cosmetic armor, and new camera perspectives are just a few of the exciting new elements waiting to be discovered. Technical players and builders haven't been forgotten either. Decorations, numerous new building blocks, and pre-industrialization give the pack the finishing touches without making it feel cluttered. You can build your own charming village and live a quiet, solitary life, or construct a steampunk metropolis with its own train stations and enjoy your train lines thanks to the many visual enhancements. I hope you enjoy the project and will contribute to its development in the future. Have fun!
